contact.subject: Contact Information
contact.preview: Get in touch for collaboration opportunities, job inquiries, or just to say hello.
contact.content: I'm always open to new opportunities and collaborations. Whether you're looking for a developer for your next project, have a job opportunity, or just want to connect, feel free to reach out. I am particularly interested in software development and engineering roles. I am based in Bengaluru, India and am available for remote work opportunities worldwide.

contact.subject: About Me
contact.preview: Software Developer with a passion for designing scalable systems and solving complex problems.
contact.content: I am a passionate Software Developer with a strong background in designing and implementing scalable systems. My expertise lies in improving system performance and reliability, as demonstrated by my work on alerting and self-healing systems, and my experience in optimizing backup processes and cloud expenditure. I enjoy tackling complex technical challenges and contributing to impactful projects. When I'm not coding, I'm often exploring new technologies or sharing knowledge with the developer community.
